stories.title: North Wales pays Britain’s highest electricity charges as Flintshire MS calls for cheaper power, not net zero at any price
stories.summary: Households in North Wales pay the highest electricity prices in Great Britain, figures from energy regulator Ofgem show. stories.title: Sixteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Mold worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Mold face 10 sets of roadworks today, with Llys Nercwys closed until Wednesday 2 December.

stories.title: Black Friday warning as fake phone network scams hit 15,000 cases
stories.summary: Scams by fraudsters pretending to be mobile phone networks are up 85% this year. There have been more than 15,000 cases so far, which is 58 a day, according to fraud prevention service Cifas. Losses have passed an estimated £32 million. The scammers offer cheap handsets, free upgrades or time-limited Black Friday and Christmas deals

stories.title: Wales among worst places in UK for cost of a private filling, watchdog says
stories.summary: A private white filling in Wales costs more than a third of what the average person has left to spend in a week after tax, the competition watchdog says. stories.title: Mold Broncoed voters choose new Flintshire councillor today from seven candidates
stories.summary: Polls are open in Mold’s Broncoed ward today, as voters choose a new Flintshire county councillor. Voting runs from 7am until 10pm. The ward has one polling station, at Bethesda Presbyterian Chapel Schoolroom on New Street. Seven candidates are standing for the single seat.
